{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_rows = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the conversion fraction
num_converted = loyal_rows['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(loyal_rows)
conversion_fraction = num_converted / num_total

# Print all required numbers explicitly
print("Number of loyal customers:", num_total)
print("Number converted:", num_converted)
print("Conversion fraction:", conversion_fraction)

# Return the fraction for submission
conversion_fraction"}
